title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Untapwp Vidplex…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Untapwp Vidplex versions up to 1.0.3. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating medium severity.
